mapper.select: /** com.khnp.pels.api.TstEventSelectList */ SELECT T1.EVENT_SNO, T1.EVENT_TYP_SQNO, T1.PWPL_ID, T1.CHCK_SNO, T1.PAGE_CNT, T1.INSRTN_PAGE_CNT, T1.PDF_PAGE_CNT, CASE WHEN T1.EVENT_TYP_SQNO IN (3,4) THEN T1.EVENT_DOC_SQNO ELSE NULL END AS STRK_SEQ, CASE WHEN T1.EVENT_TYP_SQNO IN (5,6,7,8) THEN T1.EVENT_DOC_SQNO ELSE NULL END AS IMG_SEQ, T1.USER_ID, TO_CHAR(T1.EVENT_CRTE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3') AS EVENT_CRTE_DT, T2.X_CRDNT AS STRK_POS_X, T2.Y_CRDNT AS STRK_POS_Y, T2.LINE_SNO, T2.LINE_ETT, T3.X_CRDNT AS IMG_POS_X, T3.Y_CRDNT AS IMG_POS_Y, T3.WDTH_NUMV, T3.HDTH_NUMV, T3.URL_INFO FROM GE_PL_EVNT01_M T1 LEFT JOIN GE_PL_EVNT0101_D T2 ON T1.EVENT_SNO = T2.EVENT_SNO LEFT JOIN GE_PL_EVNT0102_D T3 ON T1.EVENT_SNO = T3.EVENT_SNO WHERE T1.PWPL_ID = #{pwplId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND T1.CHCK_SNO = #{chckSno, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY T1.EVENT_CRTE_DT , T1.EVENT_SNO
